question:
Assertion (A): The shortest distance between two parallel lines $\vec r=\vec a_1+\lambda\vec b$ and $\vec r=\vec a_2+\mu\vec b$ is $\frac{|\vec b \times (\vec a_2-\vec a_1)|}{|\vec b|}$.

Reason (R): For two skew lines the shortest distance is $\frac{|(\vec b_1 \times \vec b_2)\cdot(\vec a_2-\vec a_1)|}{|\vec b_1 \times \vec b_2|}$.

options.A: Both Assertion and Reason are true and Reason explains Assertion.
options.B: Both Assertion and Reason are true but Reason does not explain Assertion.
